svg.title: A lost response does not prove a failed write
svg.desc: A write can commit before the response is lost. An atomic same-key retry can return the existing effect.

g.text: A lost response does not prove a failed write
Commit succeeds → response is lost → client is uncertain
Retry with the same key: return the existing durable effect.
Assumes atomic deduplication with effect storage; remote effects need their own protocol.
Illustrative model · use the interactive version to explore the behavior
